criteria.description: When no DNSProjectionSource is configured, existing Nostr projector behavior and system discovery DNS capabilities remain unchanged.

When DNSProjectionSource is configured, RepublishSnapshot publishes kind 31976 DNSEndpointState events with d, family, environment, health, runtime, dns, addr, proto, port, t:dns-endpoint, and t:bahia tags where applicable.
Previously published DNS endpoint coordinates that disappear from the source are replaced with kind 31976 tombstone events using deleted=true.
System discovery advertises dns_endpoint_catalog and dns_endpoint_state kind 31976 only when DNS projection is configured.

When dns.enabled=true, app wiring constructs DNS zones, filesystem backends, resolver bridge, DNSProjector, DNSReconciler, registers the reconciler, and injects WithDNSProjectionSource into the Nostr projector.
Documentation identifies kind 31976 as active Phase 0 behavior and DNS operator kinds 5941-5945/6941/7941-7945 as reserved, not reactor-accepted.
